function.name: auto_shade
function.description: Shades flat-colored shapes like an anime pixel artist: every same-color region gets hue-shifted 2-4 tone cel shading that follows its outline (lit edges toward the light, shadow on the far side), layers ABOVE cast shadows onto it (bangs on the forehead, head on the neck), optional rim light. Workflow: block the character in flat colors on separate layers (hair back, body, face, hair front), auto_shade each, outline mode=selout, then hand-paint eyes and highlights. Regions smaller than min_region (eyes, buttons) and 'preserve' colors are untouched.
